reasons: Section 11.1 as drafted (immediate cessation of all assistance plus permanent deletion with no export or migration support) sits squarely in the rule's walk-away territory, so a deviation finding is correct and is not merely upgrading an acceptable fallback.

The replacement text reaches the preferred position on the element that was missing (up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates) and sensibly subordinates deletion to the existing Sections 11.2-11.3, which already deliver the 30-day machine-readable return and certified deletion — avoiding duplicative or conflicting language.

The high changed-character ratio is justified: the original sentence is entirely contrary to the playbook position and cannot be fixed by an insertion, so a whole-clause replacement is the smallest edit that reaches the position.
Comment is accurate, concise, in first person plural, cites the playbook position, explains the internal contradiction with Sections 10.1/11.2/11.3, and offers the 90-day fallback.
